title: Ashbury Rewards Points Transfer Terms
content:
**1. Giving points.** A member may give points from their own account to another Ashbury Rewards member; giving away points is the sender's own decision.

**2. Quantity, fee and finality.** Points are transferred in multiples of the tier's transfer increment, without a fee, and a completed transfer is irrevocable when the tier's setting makes transfers irrevocable.

**3. Accounts.** Both accounts must be active, and the sender must hold at least the points transferred.

**4. Account age.** Both accounts must have been open for the tier's minimum number of days since enrolment before a transfer. The age of each account is counted in whole calendar days from its enrolment date, which is day zero; a transfer on the day both accounts reach the minimum is allowed.

**5. Frequency.** A sender makes at most one transfer to the same recipient on one calendar day.

**6. Arrival.** The recipient's arrival transaction mirrors the sender's transfer and names it.

## Retired clause

> **No longer in force.** The clause "The sender's transfers in the calendar year, counted with the points transferred out in the calendar year and including this transfer, may not exceed the annual transfer-out cap of the sender's tier, and the recipient's receipts, counted with the points received in the calendar year and including this transfer, may not exceed the annual transfer-in cap of the recipient's tier" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for the transfer allowance.

## Boundary cases on account age (hypothetical dates, minimum of 30 days)

| Sender enrolled | Recipient enrolled | Transfer date | Sender's day count | Recipient's day count | Allowed under term 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2026 | 10 March 2026 | 9 April 2026 | 39 | 30 | Yes — the day both accounts reach the minimum |
| 1 March 2026 | 10 March 2026 | 8 April 2026 | 38 | 29 | No |

## Points of judgement

- A second transfer from the same sender to the same recipient on the same calendar day is not made; a transfer to a different recipient that day is not affected by term 5.
- A sender whose balance is below the points requested fails term 3.

superseded_clauses: The sender's transfers in the calendar year, counted with loyalty_msr_transferred_out_ytd and including this transfer, may not exceed points_transfer_out_annual_cap of the sender's tier, and the recipient's receipts, counted with loyalty_msr_received_ytd and including this transfer, may not exceed points_transfer_in_annual_cap of the recipient's tier.
